title: Define truth status for rumors, reports, observations, and confirmed facts
description:
Define truth-status semantics for campaign overlay lore.

The system needs to record that something was said, believed, observed, reported, confirmed, disproven, or lied about without collapsing all of those into "true".

Acceptance criteria:
- Define a constrained truth-status vocabulary.
- Include at least:
  - true or confirmed
  - false or disproven
  - unknown
  - rumored
  - reported
  - observed
  - believed
  - lie
  - exaggeration
- Explain the difference between:
  - "Old Renn's mule returned alone" as reported/observed evidence
  - "Old Renn was taken by goblins" as rumor/belief unless confirmed
- Define whether truth status is player-visible, DM-only, or can have separate public/private values.
- Define how truth status changes over time when play confirms or disproves a rumor.
- Include audit rules for truth status:
  - a recorded rumor supports "NPCs say X"
  - it does not support "X is true" unless separately confirmed
close_reason: Implemented campaign overlay canon, truth-statused lore recording, world_query retrieval/search, audit/prompt guidance, docs, and regression coverage.
